title: Sleeps 14 • East Nash • 8 Min to Broadway • Groups
description:
Sleeps 14 • 4.99⭐ Superhost • East Nashville

Built for group trips, bachelorette weekends, and family getaways. With 6 comfortable beds, 3 full bathrooms (no waiting to get ready!), walk-in closets, and spacious common areas, everyone stays together in comfort. Located in vibrant East Nashville, just minutes to Broadway, restaurants, breweries, and live music. Free parking + pet friendly.

The space
•Designed for Group Getaways• 

Bringing the whole crew to Nashville? This spacious home was designed with large groups in mind — from unforgettable bachelorette weekends to wedding celebrations and family reunions.

✔ Sleeps up to 14 guests
✔ 6 cozy beds
✔ 3 full bathrooms (huge for getting ready!)
✔ Walk-in closets + ensuite setups
✔ Free parking
✔ Pet friendly

No splitting up into multiple hotel rooms. No juggling different rentals. Just one comfortable, stylish home base for your entire group.

•Space to Gather• 

The open common areas make it easy to:
• Get ready together before a night on Broadway
• Host brunch at home
• Relax and recharge after exploring the city

With thoughtful layouts and multiple bathrooms, everyone can spread out and enjoy the stay.

•Prime East Nashville Location• 

Stay in one of Nashville’s most vibrant neighborhoods while being just a short Uber ride to:

• Broadway Honky Tonks
• Nissan Stadium
• Top-rated restaurants & coffee shops
• Local breweries & live music venues

You get the energy of Nashville without being stuck downtown.

•Trusted Stay• 

With a 4.99⭐ rating and Superhost status, we take pride in providing a clean, seamless, and memorable experience for every group.

As a locally owned and self-managed home, you’ll be communicating directly with us — not a large management company — so we can ensure every detail of your stay is handled with care.

Guest access
You’ll have private access to the entire home during your stay — no shared spaces.

Easy self check-in with a secure keypad entry (your unique code will be sent before arrival).

Guests also have access to the driveway for free parking and all indoor/outdoor spaces shown in the listing.
